xteink_x3.name: Xteink X3
xteink_x3.firmware_update_instructions: Eject the SD card or close File Transfer. On Xteink X3, use the arrow and confirm buttons to open Settings → System → SD Card Firmware Update, select passage-xteink-x3.bin, and confirm. Keep the reader powered until it restarts. Then open a book and confirm Sync Highlights appears in the reader menu.
xteink_x3.support_note: Highlight selection uses the arrow and Confirm buttons; this model has no touchscreen.
